run_pipeline_normals_estimation: run monocular normals estimation pipeline on a PIL image and save the visualization
run_ensemble_normals_prediction: run ensemble normals prediction with multiple diffusion steps and compute uncertainty maps
run_latent_reuse_inference: run inference reusing latents from a previous pipeline call for consistent multi-step generation
run_custom_processing_resolution: run normals estimation with custom processing resolution and output format control
run_ensemble_closest_reduction: run ensemble normals with closest reduction method to select the most confident prediction per pixel
